statement: The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture. For every fixed d ≥ 3, any n ≥ 2 distinct points in ℝd determine at least $`c_dn^{2/d}`$ distinct distances, with $`c_d\gt 0`$ depending only on dimension. This matches the integer-grid order and resolves the higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture with a constant-factor bound.
